---
title: "L04: Immunosuppressants"
description: "ATC L04 holds the immunosuppressants, drugs that dampen the immune system, from calcineurin inhibitors used after transplants to TNF and JAK inhibitors."
date: "2026-09-22"
---

L04 has a single level-3 group, [L04A](l04a/), and WHO gives both the same name.
L04A sorts the immunosuppressants into level-4 groups, mostly by what they block, such as calcineurin, TNF-α, interleukins and the Janus kinases.
